actions.description: release every key: slow down and wait
run right with A held (fire Mario throws a fireball each time A is pressed again)
jump straight up, or keep holding jump to rise higher
jump while walking right, or keep holding jump
jump while running right, or keep holding jump

notes: outcome[action] is a physics lookahead of about 0.9 s, starting after the input lag. It holds that action for one decision, then keeps going the same direction: a jump already started stays held while it still boosts, and Mario hops on his own at pits, walls and enemies ahead. fate is one of: safe; stomp (lands on an enemy, which is fine); hurt (touches an enemy, piranha or bullet, and small Mario dies); pit (falls to death). t = ms until that harm. gain = tiles moved right by the end. Rules: when status is none, press jump or idle; when it is dying or won, idle. Never choose jump, jumpRight or runJumpRight when onGround is true and jumpReady is false, or when onGround is false and boosting is false (holding S then only stops the next jump from starting). From the actions left, keep those whose fate is safe or stomp. If onGround is false, boosting is true and at least one jump action is safe, keep only the jump actions. Take the highest gain. On the ground, if a non-jump action is within 0.5 of that gain, take the best non-jump action instead, so Mario jumps only when it helps. Actions within 0.1 gain of each other are equally good. If no action is safe, take the one with the largest t; when big is true, hurt beats pit. threat (nearest danger), pitAhead/pitWidth and wallAhead/wallHeight (tiles from Mario's front) tell what the outcomes are reacting to.
